sources.label: Morphe patches for Pdb (pdb.app): premium unlock, ad removal, PairIP bypass and
sources.author: Madusha
patch_list: No-ops the Google Mobile Ads initialisation so the ad SDK never starts.
Disables Crashlytics, Google Analytics v3, Firebase measurement and Flurry components and sets the Firebase/GA collection opt-outs. FCM push is kept.
No-ops the Adjust (attribution) and Flurry (analytics) SDK initialisers so no tracking payload is collected or sent.
Disables every ad-network component TextNow declares (AdMarvel, Amazon, AppNext, Google Mobile Ads, MoPub) and strips the ad-ID / ad-services / install-referrer permissions.
